title: Reality survives semisimplification
statement:
The semisimplification of an $\iota$-real lisse Weil sheaf (of the
Weil monodromy representation of
[def-wf-monodromy-data]) is $\iota$-real and has the same local
characteristic polynomials.

proof.text: Let $\mathcal F$ be the given $\iota$-real lisse Weil sheaf, and let $(V,\rho)$ be its finite-dimensional Weil representation in [def-wf-monodromy-data]. If $V=0$, its semisimplification is the empty direct sum, again zero; both local determinant factors are $1$, so the conclusion holds. Hence assume $V\ne0$. By [lem-mg-composition-series-exists], choose a composition series $0=V_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq V_t=V$. By [def-mg-weil-composition-series], each $V_i$ is Weil-stable and its successive quotient $Q_i=V_i/V_{i-1}$ is simple.

source.place: Proof, composition filtration and local determinant calculation

proof.text: The exact tensor equivalence [prop-wf-weil-sheaf-representation-equivalence] identifies subobjects, quotients and subquotients on the sheaf and representation sides. Thus the inclusions $V_i\subset V$ correspond to lisse Weil subsheaves $\mathcal F_i\subset\mathcal F$, and $Q_i$ corresponds to $\mathcal F_i/\mathcal F_{i-1}$. By [def-mg-weil-semisimplification], $S=V^{\mathrm{ss}}=\bigoplus_{i=1}^t Q_i$. The sheaf corresponding to $S$ is $\mathcal F^{\mathrm{ss}}=\bigoplus_{i=1}^t\mathcal F_i/\mathcal F_{i-1}$: the finite direct sum is the biproduct, hence is preserved by the equivalence. In particular this is a lisse Weil sheaf.

source.place: Proof, composition filtration and local determinant calculation

proof.text:
Fix an arbitrary closed point $x$ and a local geometric Frobenius element $g_x$ in the Weil group. By [p-real-operations], $P_x(\mathcal F,T)=\det(1-T\rho(g_x)\mid V)$. Every $V_i$ is stable under $\rho(g_x)$, since it is Weil-stable by [def-mg-weil-composition-series]. The induced action on $V_i/V_{i-1}$ is exactly $Q_i(g_x)$ by the quotient representation. For the current statement of [p-linear-filtration], put $\chi_h(U)=\det(U-h)$. Iterating its invariant-subspace formula along the filtration gives $\chi_{\rho(g_x)}(U)=\prod_i\chi_{Q_i(g_x)}(U)$. In the Laurent polynomial ring, $\det(1-Th)=T^{\dim M}\chi_h(T^{-1})$ for an endomorphism $h$ of $M$. Since $\dim V=\sum_i\dim Q_i$, substitution $U=T^{-1}$ and multiplication by $T^{\dim V}$ give an equality in $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell[T]$ (which injects into its Laurent polynomial ring). Thus
$$P_x(\mathcal F,T)=\prod_{i=1}^t\det(1-TQ_i(g_x)\mid Q_i).$$

source.place: Proof, composition filtration and local determinant calculation

proof.text:
The semisimplification $S=\bigoplus_i Q_i$ of [def-mg-weil-semisimplification] has the componentwise Weil action of [def-real-weil-representation-operations]. Its partial sums $S_j=\bigoplus_{i=1}^j Q_i$ form a finite invariant filtration; the map $S_j\to Q_j$ selecting the last coordinate has kernel $S_{j-1}$ and intertwines the Weil actions, so its graded action is $Q_j(g_x)$. Iterate [p-linear-filtration] on $S_\bullet$ and use the reciprocal-polynomial identity from Step 3; applying [p-real-operations] to the corresponding sheaf gives
$$P_x(\mathcal F^{\mathrm{ss}},T)=\det(1-TS(g_x)\mid S)=\prod_{i=1}^t\det(1-TQ_i(g_x)\mid Q_i)=P_x(\mathcal F,T).$$
This works for every choice of composition series and every closed point $x$.

source.place: Proof, composition filtration and local determinant calculation

proof.text: By [def-wf-iota-real], $\iota$-reality means that every coefficient of $\iota(P_x(\mathcal F,T))$ is real for every closed point $x$. The equality of local polynomials in the preceding step gives the same coefficient condition for $\mathcal F^{\mathrm{ss}}$ at each $x$. Hence $\mathcal F^{\mathrm{ss}}$ is $\iota$-real, with exactly the same local characteristic polynomials as $\mathcal F$.

lean.statement: theorem isReal_semisimplification {K : Type u} [Field K] [Finite K] {C : Scheme.{u}} {p : C ⟶ Spec (.of K)} [IsCurve p] (W : WeilGroup p) {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] [Fact (ringChar K ≠ l)] {n : Type u} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (D : Monodromy.RepresentedDegreeDatum W.carrier n (PadicAlgCl l)) (ι : PadicAlgCl l →+* ℂ) (hLisse : W.IsLisse l D.asRepresentation) (hReal : W.IsReal l D.asRepresentation ι) (s : D.asRepresentation.CompositionSeries) : W.IsLisse l s.semisimplification ∧ W.IsReal l s.semisimplification ι ∧ ∀ x : C.finitePoints, W.localPolynomial l s.semisimplification x = W.localPolynomial l D.asRepresentation x
lean.note: Uses the published Weil-representation presentation of lisse Weil sheaves in WeilConjectures.EtaleCohomology.Purity.RealSheaves.Basic/Weights/Operations. D.asRepresentation is exactly the representation of the recorded monodromy datum, and s.semisimplification is the recorded direct sum of its successive quotient representations. Reality and local factors use the existing WeilGroup predicates, with the same coefficientwise condition as WeilSheaf.IsReal in the recorded Stalk module. The theorem covers every composition series, including the zero-dimensional empty series.
